description: Cafunfo police describes armed rebellion; witnesses and organizers describe a public protest. Later UNITA and UFOLO investigations need full reading. This changes MM eligibility, beyond the question of crowd size.
required_followup: Recover police statement and original investigative reports, compare observed actions and timing, then independently decide MM armed-rebellion exclusion.

description: Cafunfo physical closure unknown; sources give different tolls at different reporting dates and pre-event versus post-event arrest counts. No common toll or victim category inferred.
required_followup: Separate dead protesters, bystanders and other victims, verify each attribution and arrest timing, and establish physical end independently of aftermath news.

description: Ngola Kiluange and eastern protests described only as dozens in a DW republication. Original DW article not recovered; no independent crowd verification.
required_followup: Locate original DW report/video and independent contemporary local reporting, establish at least 50 attendees at relevant physical units.

description: Eastern protest report names three provinces but no individual meeting places or unambiguous date for each. A single grouped candidate is provisional.
required_followup: Identify sites, dates, organizers and coordinated plan before splitting, merging or assigning episode start precision.

description: Ngola Kiluange demands public services and district investment. Available seven-category dictionary lacks a specific public-services category; no arbitrary price/labor mapping assigned.
required_followup: Calibrate original demand mapping against the manual and original MM cases.

description: Physical end and most state responses remain unknown for the January16 local march and eastern lead.
required_followup: Follow local reports immediately after action; do not replace unknown with ignore or assume one-day duration.

description: Radio Angola, UFOLO report PDF and mirror, Club-K reports, Cabinda announcement and legal-petition pages failed to open. December10 AMP failed but canonical DW opened. Search-only content not promoted into coding evidence.
required_followup: Try lawful original/archived copies or parallel contemporary reporting; preserve access failure details.

description: English/Portuguese open-web general, weekly, sector and regional discovery performed. Date operators returned 2025–2026 material; exact quoted week searches also returned irrelevant countries. Not equivalent to systematic LexisNexis/newspaper archive coverage.
required_followup: Search systematic contemporary archives; rerun January1–15 and January22–29 windows with local outlet archives and strict article-date checks.

description: No Chokwe, Kikongo, Kimbundu, Umbundu or other Angolan-language archive search. Coverage weak outside Luanda and the eastern provinces, especially Cabinda, Benguela/Lobito, Huambo, Huíla, Uíge, Bié, Namibe, Cunene and rural locations.
required_followup: Conduct local-language and provincial archival review; absence of discovered reports is not absence of events.

description: Official current dataset bytes/schema/universe unavailable; DOI registration metadata recovered by coordinator is not latest-file verification. Additional Coding Procedure not retrieved in this unit.
required_followup: Coordinator resolves official file version and supplementary coding rules before export or final eligibility approval.

description: December10 Luanda protest, February1 Cabinda announcement, February4 Luanda solidarity action and threatened February15 nurses strike belong outside January. Boundary checks do not prove continuous action into January or execution of announced strikes.
required_followup: Route boundary leads to correct months, verify occurrence and distinguish solidarity campaigns from physically continuous protest.

description: UFOLO mirror opening rejected 18,015,983-byte size; PDF itself not read. Mosaiko search excerpts contain January31 alongside January30, requiring checking chronology before use.
required_followup: Read lawful original research report in manageable form; inspect Mosaiko date discrepancy and compare contemporary January30 accounts.

description: Lusa text is republished across multiple websites. Wikinews nurse story depends on VOA. Source registry rows and access totals are not independent confirmations.
required_followup: Trace original agencies and avoid counting repeated text as corroboration.

description: Per-query and per-source exact timestamps were not captured. Previously rounded/reconstructed minute estimates were discarded; null fields and timing notes explicitly preserve this limitation. Real session assignment and finish timestamps remain available.
required_followup: Use retained query order, source references and session assignment for provenance; future research should capture execution clock at each call.
